nullModel: Within each draw and prize tier, physical prize-outlet occurrences are allocated across provinces proportionally to that draw’s official SELAE sales amount.
multipleTesting: Family-wise empirical p-value uses the maximum absolute standardized residual across eligible provinces in every bootstrap replicate.

interpretation.warning: Even a residual geographic anomaly would describe distribution/consignment of winning numbers across outlets, not a causal increase in a ticket number’s probability of winning by purchase location.
